name: Canonical Deterministic Contract Risk Formula
description: Shared mathematical and pattern definition between Python (FastAPI/Flask) and Node.js runtimes to eliminate architectural split-brain.

hazard_patterns.reason: Explicit unlimited liability exposure detected without standard indemnification caps.
Perpetual duration or automatic renewal lock-in without mandatory prior notice.
Unilateral modification rights granting one party unchecked discretion.
Broad waiver of claims or statutory warranty protections.
Immediate termination without cure period or required default notice.

canonical_test_vectors.text: This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement is entered into by and between the parties. Each party agrees to hold the other's proprietary information in strict confidence with reasonable care. Term is two years.
Vendor agrees to assume unlimited liability for any intellectual property disputes arising under this agreement.
This agreement shall automatically renew perpetually. Company reserves the right at its sole and absolute discretion to alter service parameters at any time.
Vendor assumes unlimited liability. Customer may execute immediate termination without cause. Customer waives all warranties and all fees are strictly non-refundable.

Parties agree to unlimited liability with no cap on liability. The agreement binds parties in perpetuity. Licensor maintains sole and absolute discretion over all source data. All payments are non-refundable and Licensee waives all rights. Licensor may order immediate termination without notice.
